items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: If you knew anything about Harold Baker or Louie, that's the kind of style that he played

ctx.x: A terrific soloist; when he played a solo he never did break the tone. It was just as beautiful as he was playing a sweet solo. If you knew anything about Harold Baker or Louie, that's the kind of style that he played, and he read so slow and you'd have to wait and drill and drill.
Who was first in the band?
